# CodexMeter 2.0.8
The Pro fix from 2.0.7, working this time.
## What changed
- **ChatGPT Pro's phantom five-hour window is actually hidden now.** 2.0.7 read your plan from the account saved inside CodexMeter — which is empty unless you explicitly added one, so for most people the plan came back unknown and the window stayed on screen. It now reads the plan from the Codex login you are actually signed in with.
## Verification
- 600 automated tests, 0 failures (9 environment-integration tests skipped). - `swift build` with zero warnings and zero errors. - Universal 2 build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later. - Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. SHA-256 protects the first download; Sparkle authenticates later updates with Ed25519 signatures.
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
## First direct-download launch
Download `CodexMeter-2.0.8.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` into the same folder and verify the checksum before opening:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-2.0.8.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-2.0.8.dmg ```
## Recovery
This release does not migrate any database. Published version tags are immutable; corrections ship as a new patch release.
